l1_words.meaning: to attend, to be present at
to put up with, to endure

pattern_explanation: Spanish and English share many Latin roots, so numerous words look alike in both languages. Some of these look-alikes have drifted apart in meaning over time, so a similar form does not guarantee the same sense.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish word meaning 'pregnant' looks like the English word 'embarrassed', but the two words mean completely different things, so it must be matched with 'pregnant' and never with 'embarrassed'.
